png_conversion.source: Original SVG by default. For entries png_source_kind=commons_png, the pinned Commons PNG rendition is used because the local SVG renderer loses sign geometry; source bytes identified by png_source_sha256. Per-entry png_renderer and png_renderer_version override the default tool; DE:1044-10 requires ImageMagick 7.1.2-31 to preserve its clipped white face and outline.
